why-and-how-a-hand-book-for-the-use-of-t: Addie Chisholm's handbook gave Canada's temperance women the facts, reasons, and working plans for their war on drink. Plain field counsel joins a burning moral call on every page. A telling relic of the great dry crusade that changed life north and south of the border.
the-history-of-education-educational-pra: Ellwood Cubberley's History of Education — practice and progress considered as phases of civilization — became the standard American textbook on the subject. His broad survey, from ancient schools to modern systems, shaped generations of teachers. The classic history of schooling in America.
